governing_rule: no child safety by placement row
matrix_role: tests for child protection, foster care, family preservation, court authority, placement suitability, health, education, missing-from-care, medication monitoring, youth voice, permanency, and oversight continuity claims

CW-01.fail_or_repair: Open an intake and investigation clock; downgrade any claim that treats hotline status as safety.
CW-01.label: Intake, screen, and investigation clock
CW-01.question: Does the packet separate referral, reporter, allegation, screen result, response priority, investigation actions, safety assessment, disposition, notice, and appeal before calling a child safe?

CW-02.fail_or_repair: Do not treat a prevention plan or program authority as family preservation until service delivery and timing are visible.
CW-02.label: Prevention and family-support delivery
CW-02.question: Can the packet prove prevention, reasonable efforts, kinship help, in-home supports, disability/language access, and economic stabilizers were actually reachable before removal or reunification failure?

CW-03.fail_or_repair: Open a legal-authority docket before treating custody status as due process.
CW-03.label: Removal, court authority, and notice
CW-03.question: Does the packet distinguish emergency removal, voluntary placement, custody order, counsel, GAL/CASA, parent notice, youth notice, tribal notice, review hearing, and appeal route?

CW-04.fail_or_repair: Do not treat an available bed or placement row as appropriate placement.
CW-04.label: Placement suitability, kinship, siblings, and tribal continuity
CW-04.question: Can the packet show why the placement is least restrictive, family-approximating, kin/sibling/tribal-aware, school-preserving, disability/behavioral-health appropriate, and safely monitored?

CW-05.fail_or_repair: Do not infer health or school continuity from eligibility, placement, or medication rows.
CW-05.label: Health, Medicaid, trauma, medication, and education passport
CW-05.question: Are insurance, medical records, trauma screening, therapy, psychotropic consent/monitoring, dental, disability supports, school enrollment, IEP/504, credits, and transportation joined?

CW-06.fail_or_repair: Do not close a missing episode on return date alone; require return assessment and prevention repair.
CW-06.label: Missing-from-care report, search, return, and trafficking screen
CW-06.question: When a child is missing from care or returns, does the packet show law-enforcement/NCMEC/NCIC route where required, search plan, caregiver/court/attorney notice, return interview, trafficking screen, and revised prevention plan?

CW-07.fail_or_repair: Treat contracted capacity as unproven until child-specific capacity and escalation are visible.
CW-07.label: Caseworker contact, supervision, provider capacity, and incident escalation
CW-07.question: Does the packet prove caseworker visits, supervisor review, provider capacity, incident reporting, specialized placement availability, and escalation authority?

CW-08.fail_or_repair: Do not treat a permanency goal or case closure as durable permanency.
CW-08.label: Family time, permanency, and transition clocks
CW-08.question: Does the packet join family time, reunification services, guardianship/adoption route, APPLA/aging-out, documents, benefits, housing, education/work, and post-exit support?

CW-09.fail_or_repair: Add a voice and contestability route before accepting case-plan compliance.
CW-09.label: Child/youth voice, counsel, grievance, and retaliation-safe route
CW-09.question: Can the child, youth, parent, kin caregiver, tribe, or representative contest facts, services, placement, school, health, medication, family-time, or permanency without losing safety or support?

CW-10.fail_or_repair: Do not cite aggregate child-welfare data as child-specific safety or permanency proof.
CW-10.label: Aggregate data and public oversight denominator
CW-10.question: Are AFCARS, NCANDS/Child Maltreatment, CFSR, NYTD, state dashboards, audits, and provider reports labeled by denominator, refresh clock, exclusion, and case-level repair path?
